text_en: About a month later, Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh-gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you. ”
text_cn: 大约过了一个月，阿孟人纳哈士上来围困基肋阿得的雅贝士，雅贝士所有的居民对纳哈士说：“你与我们立约，我们就服事你。”

text_en: But Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make a treaty with you, namely that I gouge out everyone’s right eye, and thus put disgrace upon all Israel. ”
text_cn: 阿孟人纳哈士回答他们说：“在这条件下，我才与你们立约：就是剜出你们各人的右眼，我要借此羞辱全以色列。”

text_en: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days’ respite that we may send messengers through all the territory of Israel. Then, if there is no one to save us, we will give ourselves up to you. ”
text_cn: 雅贝士的长老回答他说：“请让我们休战七天，我们派人到以色列全境去，如果没有人来救我们，我们就向你投降。”

text_en: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, they reported the matter in the hearing of the people; and all the people wept aloud.
text_cn: 使者到了撒乌耳的基贝亚，就把这事讲给民众听，民众遂放声大哭。

text_en: Now Saul was coming from the field behind the oxen; and Saul said, “What is the matter with the people, that they are weeping? ” So they told him the message from the inhabitants of Jabesh.
text_cn: 那时撒乌耳正跟着牛从田间回来，便问说：“民众有什么事，如此号淘大哭？”人们就把雅贝士人的话讲给他听。

text_en: And the spirit of God came upon Saul in power when he heard these words, and his anger was greatly kindled.
text_cn: 撒乌耳一听说这些话，上主的神便降在他身上， 遂勃然大怒，

text_en: He took a yoke of oxen, and cut them in pieces and sent them throughout all the territory of Israel by messengers, saying, “Whoever does not come out after Saul and Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen! ” Then the dread of the Lord fell upon the people, and they came out as one.
text_cn: 立即牵了一对牛来，剖分成块，托使者分送到以色列全境说：“凡不随从撒乌耳和撒慕尔出征的，也必这样对待他的牛！”上主的惊吓降在民众身上，因而他们好像一个人一齐出征。

text_en: When he mustered them at Bezek, those from Israel were three hundred thousand, and those from Judah seventy thousand.
text_cn: 撒乌耳在贝则克检阅了他们；以色列人共计三十万，犹大人三万。

text_en: They said to the messengers who had come, “Thus shall you say to the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead: ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you shall have deliverance. ’” When the messengers came and told the inhabitants of Jabesh, they rejoiced.
text_cn: 撒乌耳对来的使者说：“你们这样对基肋阿得的雅贝士人说：明天太阳正热时，救援就必达到你们那里。”使者便回去，向雅贝士人报告，他们都很喜欢。

text_en: So the inhabitants of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will give ourselves up to you, and you may do to us whatever seems good to you. ”
text_cn: 雅贝士人遂对阿孟人说：“明天我们向你们投降，你们看着怎样好，就怎样对待我们吧！”

text_en: The next day Saul put the people in three companies. At the morning watch they came into the camp and cut down the Ammonites until the heat of the day; and those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.
text_cn: 第二天撒乌耳把民众分作三队，在黎明以前冲入了阿孟人营中，击杀他们一直到日中最热的时候；剩下的人都逃散了，以至没有两人在一起。

text_en: The people said to Samuel, “Who is it that said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us? ’ Give them to us so that we may put them to death. ”
text_cn: 民众于是对撒慕尔说：“谁曾说过：撒乌耳岂能作我们的君王？把这些人交出来，让我们处死他们！”

text_en: But Saul said, “No one shall be put to death this day, for today the Lord has brought deliverance to Israel. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答说：“今天不可处死任何人，因为今天上主在以色列中施行了救恩。”

text_en: Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔以后对民众说：“来，我们到基耳加耳去，在那里重新建立王国。”

text_en: So all the people went to Gilgal, and there they made Saul king before the Lord in Gilgal. There they sacrificed offerings of well-being before the Lord , and there Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced greatly.
text_cn: 民众便都去了基耳加耳，在那里于上主面前立撒乌耳为王，并给上主奉献了和平祭；撒乌耳同全体以色列人举行了盛大的盛会。
